text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A Mozambican television journalist who falsely reported that a former MP had illegally acquired a business has been convicted of criminal libel and sentenced to four months in jail, convertible to a fine.

- Rents for state-owned houses and apartments will go up by 28 per cent next month but the new rents will still be low by regional standards -- only seven per cent of the minimum wage of a civil servant.

- Swedish police have interrogated Nigel Barnett in a Mozambican prison about the 1986 murder of Swedish Prime Minister Olof Palme. Barnett, believed to be South African, is being held on a separate charge.
